title: LAMP: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision Inference of Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2601.21623v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Mixed-precision computations are a hallmark of the current stage of AI, driving the progress in large language models towards efficient, locally deployable solutions. This article addresses the floating-point computation of compositionally-rich functions, concentrating on transformer inference. Based on the rounding error analysis of a composition $f(g(\mathrm{x}))$, we provide an adaptive strategy that selects a small subset of components of $g(\mathrm{x})$ to be computed more accurately while all other computations can be carried out with lower accuracy. We then explain how this strategy can be applied to different compositions within a transformer and illustrate its overall effect on transformer inference. We study the effectiveness of this algorithm numerically on GPT-2 models and demonstrate that already very low recomputation rates allow for improvements of up to two orders of magnitude in accuracy.

translated_title: LAMP：大语言模型的前瞻式混合精度推理
translated_abstract: 混合精度计算是当前人工智能发展阶段的标志性技术，推动着大语言模型朝着高效、可本地部署的解决方案不断进步。本文研究组合丰富的函数的浮点计算问题，重点聚焦于Transformer推理。基于对复合函数 $f(g(\mathrm{x}))$ 的舍入误差分析，我们提出了一种自适应策略，该策略仅选择 $g(\mathrm{x})$ 中的一小部分组件以更高精度进行计算，而其余所有计算均可以较低精度完成。随后，我们解释了该策略如何应用于Transformer内部的不同组合结构，并阐述了其对Transformer推理的整体效果。我们在GPT-2模型上对该算法的有效性进行了数值研究，结果表明，即使非常低的重计算率也能带来高达两个数量级的精度提升。
tldr: 该论文提出LAMP方法，基于舍入误差分析构建自适应混合精度策略，只需对Transformer中极小部分组件进行高精度重计算，即可使大语言模型推理精度提升高达两个数量级。
